logp.method_description: The shake flask method was applied to measure the lipophilicity of 5FU-gallium corrole conjugates with a UV–vis spectrometer. First, the corrole complexes at different concentrations were prepared in 1-octanol presaturated with PBS (10×, pH 7.4). Then, equal volumes of the PBS presaturated with 1-octanol were added and mixed. The resulting solution was placed in a homoiothermic (25 °C) shaker at 200 rpm for 4 h. After the oil and water distribution achieved equilibrium, the concentration of corrole complexes in the oil layer was obtained by analyzing UV–vis absorption spectra. The octanol/water partition coefficient log PO/W (Po/w = Co/Cw = Ao/Aw, where A represents absorbance) of 5FU-gallium corrole conjugates was calculated by eq 1: (67-69) log𝑃o/w=log{(𝐶o)final/[(𝐶o)initial-(𝐶o)final]}
